Start with this repository's `AGENTS.md`, `.michelslab/project.yml`, `MICHELS_LAB_PROJECT.md`, current product log(s) (PROJECT_LOG.md; docs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.md), current code/UX evidence, and canonical `michels-lab/Michel-Software-Standards/standards/PERSPECTIVE_COUNCIL_STANDARD.md`. If master cross-repo access is absent, state it. **Local-first Instagram export and account-review workflow, focus batches, Followers/Pending, Android and Desktop, real Supabase authentication of workflow metadata (not raw export sync).** Do not confuse hypothesized opportunities with shipped or runtime-verified capabilities.

Analyze reliable state-machine automation, per-profile provenance, non-destructive replay, bot QA via Developer twin and explainable prioritization. Do not invent provider APIs or silently perform real Instagram actions; require explicit consent, real account audit and data boundaries. Analyze data quality, security/permission boundaries, offline/error recovery, observability, scalability, platform constraints and transferability to other Michel's Lab products. Compare AI solutions with explicit simpler rules. Every idea needs source data, cost, privacy/consent, failure mode, user override, fallback, measurement and a reason **not** to build it. Never misstate provider/physical/scientific evidence or auto-edit app code.
